decisions.bestMarket: 8.5 -114 publicly displayed on the current Colts-Chiefs prop board; a same-day Covers article earlier referenced 8.5 -108, but that older price is not treated as current executable truth
decisions.reason: This is not a projection-only play. Kansas City's official preview notes Indianapolis allowed a 41.2% pressure rate in Week 1 and Jones completed only 3-of-11 for nine yards on pressured dropbacks; Covers separately identifies Jones as the most pressured QB in Week 1 and expects Kansas City's blitz-heavy front to force him to create with his legs. Current projection references are materially above the threshold (Covers 20.48 rushing yards; MatchWiz 17.7) and Jones ran for 16 yards on three carries against Kansas City last season. The Achilles-recovery uncertainty is explicitly discounted into a conservative 60% fair probability rather than accepting the higher raw model outputs.
decisions.priceDiscipline: Preferred entry is 8.5 at -115 or better. 9.5 remains playable only at -115 or better after recalculation; PASS at 10.5+ or juice worse than -115. Verify the live sportsbook immediately before placement.

confirmedFacts: Kansas City's official Friday report lists Patrick Mahomes full/no designation and LT Josh Simmons out; this does not directly drive the Jones wager but confirms the SNF injury context.
Kansas City's official preview says Indianapolis allowed a 41.2% pressure rate on Daniel Jones in Week 1 and that Jones completed 3-of-11 passes for nine yards on 14 pressured dropbacks.
attributedReporting: Covers describes Jones as the most pressured quarterback in Week 1 and identifies Kansas City as a blitz-heavy defense that pressured Denver effectively.
modelProjections: Covers computer projection: 20.48 Jones rushing yards versus a 9.5 reference line.
MatchWiz simulation projection: 17.7 Jones rushing yards versus 8.5.
analystOpinion: Jason Logan/Covers recommends Jones over 8.5 rushing yards based on mobility, pressure and short-yardage usage.
speculation: More scramble volume under pressure is a causal expectation, not a confirmed usage guarantee; the recent Achilles recovery remains a downside risk.

decisions.reason: Current public market shows 17.5 -114. Mahomes is fully active, rushed seven times for 23 yards in Week 1, FantasyPros projects about 20.6 rushing yards, and an independent same-day analyst likes his rushing role. However, the edge is thinner than Jones' at the current prices and the Chiefs' heavy Kenneth Walker usage can suppress Mahomes scramble volume in favorable game script. Keep as a secondary lean instead of stacking two quarterback rush overs in the same SNF game.
Existing parlay leg remains below the current public main receiving-yard line around 16.5 and is not stale. No hedge or cash-out signal from this refresh.
